sloka: यथा आह रामो धर्मात्मा तत् कुरुष्व समाहितः ।राजन् तिष्ठ स्व समये भव सत्य प्रतिश्रवः ॥४-३१-५१॥
transliteration: yathā āha rāmo dharmātmā tat kuruṣva samāhitaḥ ।rājan tiṣṭha sva samaye bhava satya pratiśravaḥ ॥4-31-51॥

translations.english: 'O king be true to your promise to his brother, righteous Rama without fail. Honour the agreement.' इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये किष्किन्धाकाण्डे एकत्रिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the thirtyfirst sarga of Kishkindakanda of the Holy Ramayana, the first epic, composed by sage Valmiki.
